scope: Publish Mobile Sales APK with existing LPH receipt/claim workflow and recoverable cleanup of obsolete production application backups/staging files. WMS loading UI explicitly deferred.

android.installation: Install as an update over the current app. Do not uninstall or clear app data; preserve locally queued legacy payments.
android.workflow: Use Dashboard > LPH & Klaim Pembayaran for v2 LPH. Requires online connection and active LPH. Claims become final payments only after Finance reconciliation/finalization. Legacy v1 LPH retains its previous payment flow.

cleanup.space_note: Cleanup-only savings, excluding newly published APK and deployment bookkeeping; logical bytes are not filesystem allocated blocks.
cleanup.staging_recovery: Every removed staging file matched its retained sibling release.tar.gz member by SHA-256. Release archives and database dumps remain untouched.
cleanup.protected_file_note: aaPanel immutable flag caused the first cleanup pass to stop. Resumed safely from the verified manifest, leaving the locked .user.ini and its directory. No security flags were disabled.
preserved: Live API and ERP application code/assets
Recently modified or otherwise uncertain backup candidates
cleanup.rollback: Selectively restore required loose files from retired-app-files.tar.gz (members begin www/...). Restore obsolete staging files only from their retained release archive if necessary. Do not restore old database dumps over subsequent production transactions.

verification.mobile_browser_workflow: PASSED at 390px: accept checked invoices, save claim, return with exact cash split. All business APIs mocked; no production writes.
verification.target_lph_note: Document advanced during release preparation; its claims are locked by the workflow. No status change was made by this deployment.
